/-- `SubgroupClass S G` states `S` is a type of subsets `s ⊆ G` that are subgroups of `G`. -/
class SubgroupClass (S : Type*) (G : outParam Type*) [DivInvMonoid G] [SetLike S G] : Prop
    extends SubmonoidClass S G, InvMemClass S G
